sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate defines a canonical cross-owner path from ship to framingAngle; the available terms only identify the oblique case, its relationship, or the angle property itself.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Add the verified applicability logic: enforce the strict oblique-framing interval 20 deg < framingAngle < 70 deg and require the interpolation case only for applicable oblique plating, without making hasObliquePlatingInterpolationCase universally mandatory for every ship.
